I replied to Marcus in his #north-team thread: the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is on 25 November. Ilse posted that date in #north-team on 14 October.

I checked that Marcus is a member of #north-team before reading it. Nothing posted there since 14 October changes the date. The public North team files don't mention a Brackenwater renewal date, so they don't contradict it either. I can't see Brackenwater's own account files (contract, CRM, profile), so I couldn't check the date against those. A renewal date counts as an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it can be shared with the team.
